NGA.note: V-Pass is AI facial recognition for airport check-in, not a listed sector's public system.

facts.fact: Nigeria's aviation minister unveiled the V-Pass facial-verification system, linked to the NIN database, on 2026-11-16 at Lagos, with airlines given until 31 December 2026 to integrate it.

NGA.note: Nothing on civil register and ID links.
No enrolment count or share stated.
Nothing on who operates the ID system.
No public register keyed on the NIN stated.
Nothing on the ID system's issue, biometrics or certification.

facts.fact: Nigeria's V-Pass platform, delivered by Verxid under a PPP with FAAN, verifies domestic passengers against NIN data; launched 2026-11-16 at the Lagos and Abuja domestic terminals first, with airlines to integrate by 31 December 2026.

NGA.note: No amount stated for the PPP or any private money.
